model.name: diagram.broadcastActiveDiagram
model.description: R33.9 INV-A1/A2 signal half (design fcc9166e4): rb-diagram-detail dispatches rb-active-diagram{uuid} on render/open and {uuid:null} on disconnect - the ACTIVE-diagram signal that KILLS the fragile any/last-diagram implicit target. The host (ModelView.actionsForContext) tracks activeDiagramUuid from it. Client-only.
